pose_descriptions: ACTION: quick contact pose: reaching forward to tap or grab, one hand extended and eyes focused.
THROW: clear wind-up and release silhouette: arm draws back then reaches forward while torso twists; no object.
PUSH: brace then two-hand forward shove, torso and long tail lean firmly toward the target.
CARRY: careful upright glide with both arms locked high overhead as if carrying an invisible object; attachment hand at top of hands.
CAST: spell thrust: draw one hand back then point it firmly forward, other hand balancing; no wand or magic effect.
CLAP: looping spectator pose, both hands meeting in front of chest with an upbeat smile.
EAT: small bite gesture with one hand near mouth, happy chewing expression; no food.
BOW: polite graceful bow with head lowered and tail curling in a neat arc.
prompt:

Identity: marina has long red hair, teal eyes, gold crown set with purple jewels, purple shell top, teal scales with purple bands and large purple fins. Preserve canonical face, colors and proportions. Exactly two arms and one continuous fish tail, absolutely no legs or feet. Adapt actions with arm gestures, torso lean, tail curls and fin movement.
